images.title: Picture the profiles of a cylinder
images.purpose: Show the core move of the practice: picture a solid, then draw its outline from the side and from above.
images.composition: One cylinder in the centre with one arrow to its side profile on the left and one arrow to its top profile on the right.
images.exact_structure: Centre: one upright cylinder, radius 7 cm and height 14 cm, so exactly as wide as it is tall, filled teal #0072B2 with a lighter top ellipse, thin dark outline. Left: a square of side 14 cm drawn flat, amber #E69F00 outline and pale amber fill, with a thin arrow from the cylinder to it; label 'from the side' above it and '14 cm' along its bottom and '14 cm' along its left side. Right: a circle of radius 7 cm, amber outline and pale amber fill, a centre dot and one radius line, with a thin arrow from the top of the cylinder to it; label 'from above' over it and '7 cm' on the radius. Nothing else.

images.takeaway: This cylinder looks like a square from the side and a circle from above.
images.description: Show the core move of the practice: picture a solid, then draw its outline from the side and from above.
images.context: One clean concept image for T5.C3.
images.teaching_notes: Width 2 × 7 = 14 cm equals the height, so the side profile is a square.

image_decisions.why: The practice is about picturing outlines; one solid and its two outlines show the move exactly.
